verdict.rationale: Muse is a personal AI agent, so acting as an MCP client is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence shows users can plug in MCP servers. The closest evidence is that Muse can write its own custom connectors for services with APIs or CLIs, and build tools itself. That is self-built integration, not MCP server support, so it does not count. The probe showing no MCP server card concerns the server role and is irrelevant to this client-side story.
